brief.text: Closed-end funds represent a major theme across both lists, featuring $37.2 million in cluster purchases at BPRE alongside filings for CRAFX, NXG, and four separate funds targeted by Saba Capital. Among corporate clusters, Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP) saw an unusual surge in participation, with seven individual buyers driving a combined $22.0 million allocation. The largest single line items belonged to Rollins Inc (ROL), where two distinct 10% owners each reported identical $49.96 million transactions, well clear of the next largest individual purchases from Aspen Neuroscience (ASPE) at $20.0 million and $18.0 million.
